title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content:
Cover image: A great green bush-cricket (Tettigonia viridissima) exploring solar panels in a large, ground-mounted solar park in the Netherlands. He doesn't need to go far to find something green: such constructions could create suitable arthropod habitats between and around the panels, similar to extensive grasslands. (pp.3078–3091).
